scenario: [RLOW.6.1.10], [LTIM.4.1.1]: an `Int` asserted into a `time` unit whose product passes 2^63 - 1 nanoseconds raises NOT_REPRESENTABLE and never wraps. `n` is 106752, one day past the last whole day in the `Duration` range, so `s.n::day` is 9223372800000000000 ns. `trapped` logs the fault's kind. Exactly ["NOT_REPRESENTABLE"]. A compiler that only tags the value compares 106752 ns and fires `r`; a lowering to `Int` multiplication wraps negative. PATH PINNED: `dsc.rete.rlow_6_1_10_asserted`'s `asn_duration` arm, against libds's `adapter_ds_duration_mul` and the Mercury runtime's `ltim_4_1_1_duration_mul`.
rules_ds:
schema S scope logical:
    id: String key
    n: Int mutable

rule r:
    S s where s.n::day > 0_s
->
    log info "fired"

rule trapped:
    ComputationError c
->
    log info "{c.kind}"
